subject: Invoice flow & billing contact: portal vs email (next steps)
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@beacon-analytics.com>
Cc: billing@beacon-analytics.com, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-15T13:12:00Z
Subject: Invoice flow & billing contact: portal vs email (next steps)

Hi Oliver —

Thanks again for the call this morning. As discussed, we want to confirm Beacon's preferred invoice delivery and billing contact so we can set the initial configuration and avoid late invoices during the billing cutover. High level options: 

- Portal primary: We deliver invoices to your AP portal (sFTP/API/Peppol as applicable) and send an email copy to billing@beacon-analytics.com.
- Email primary: We send PDF invoices by email to billing@beacon-analytics.com (with optional PDF/XML attachments).

Two quick questions for you:
1) Which of the above is preferable for Beacon for recurring invoices?
2) For VAT evidence / reverse-charge handling, do you want tax IDs attached to each invoice (PDF footnote + metadata) or handled as a separate monthly bundle?

I've attached a small sample payload and our onboarding checklist so your AP team can review (see attachments). If Portal is fine, we can enable an API push on our next billing run (target July invoices). If Email is preferred, we'll set up the sender and SSO signature options so invoices arrive with consistent headers.

Can you confirm preference by EOD Wednesday so we can lock the routing?

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

Attachment: sample_invoice_payload.json (application/json)
Attachment: portal_onboarding_checklist.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@beacon-analytics.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: billing@beacon-analytics.com
Date: 2026-06-16T09:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Invoice flow & billing contact: portal vs email (next steps)

Karthik —

Appreciate the clear options. Quick answers from our side:
- Preferred: Portal primary (we can accept an API push). However, our AP team still wants an email copy for reconciliation for the first two months while they update their workflows.
- VAT: Please include tax IDs on each invoice (PDF footnote + tax_id field in invoice metadata).

A couple of practical items from procurement: who is the remit-to for wire/ACH? Also, can you include the PO number field in the JSON payload so our system auto-matches?

I'll loop in procurement if you need PO-policy confirmation.

Thanks,
Oliver
Oliver Grant
Head of Finance Operations | Beacon Analytics
oliver.grant@beacon-analytics.com

Hi Oliver —

Great — portal primary with an email copy for two months is straightforward. Answers to your procurement questions below: 

- Remit-to: Redwood Treasury (wires to Redwood Banking LLC). I'll provision the remit details in the onboarding doc and include IBAN/ACH instructions.
- PO integration: yes — we will include the PO number as an explicit "po_number" field in the JSON payload and also print it on the PDF in the header so your auto-matcher can pick it up.

Next steps I propose: 
1) I’ll send the finalized onboarding checklist (with remit details) and our API push credential instructions — action: Beacon AP to confirm acceptance.
2) Marissa, can you prepare the two-month email copy cadence and add a short reconciliation header for the PDFs?
3) Kimberly, can you confirm VAT evidence format (embedded tax_id field vs separate bundle) and any Redundancy policy for archival?

Oliver — can you confirm who on your AP side I should send the portal credentials to (name + email) so we can schedule the push for the July invoice run?

Best,
Karthik

Attachment: portal_onboarding_checklist.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Karthik / Kimberly —

I reviewed the checklist and added a short reconciliation header to the PDF template (Invoice ID / PO / Customer ref / Auto-match hint). I also added a column in the onboarding sheet for who receives credentials and the expected SFTP/API endpoint type.

Kimberly — I flagged the VAT evidence choice as "tax_id per-invoice (preferred)" but noted Beacon can request a separate evidence bundle if they want. For archival redundancy, our policy is 7 years cold storage + 2 years hot for audit samples — I left the default but can shorten to 2 years hot if Beacon requires.

I'll attach the updated checklist to the onboarding HubSpot ticket.

Marissa
